item.title: Factorio 2.1.25 released as stable
item.description:
Minor Features
  • Added depleted mining drill filter to deconstruction planner.
  • Added fluid system contents and flushing functionality to the pipe GUI.
  • Added search to the 'Select planet to drop to' GUI.
  • [space-age] Added build sounds and growth sounds for Yumako, Jellystem and Nauvis tree.
  • Joining a public game hosted on your own local network now works even on routers
